column1: Diversity and inclusion are key to Intel’s evolution, and driving forces for
continued innovation and growth. We believe that inclusive teams of
people with diverse perspectives are more creative and innovative.
Inclusion is the foundation of a high-performance workforce, where
all employees are empowered and capable of doing their best work.
Our diversity efforts go beyond hiring and retention, to also include
spending with diverse suppliers, diversifying our venture portfolio,
